figures_added.what: Distance-time graph for the average-rate-of-change hook: y-axis distance in km (20 and 80 marked), x-axis time (1 pm and 3 pm), the two data points and the straight chord joining them drawn to scale. theme-safe (currentColor axes and labels, soft blue #3b82f6 chord and points), no external refs, role=img with aria-label.

notes: This is a predominantly textual unit (average rate of change from given equations, plus iteration and sign-change, which exams print as formulae and function statements, not figures). The one place the exam would print a picture is the rate-of-change-as-gradient idea, so the opener carries an inline distance-time chord that matches its numbers (60 km over 2 h = 30 km/h; points (1pm,20) and (3pm,80)). No figure added to the MC 'positive rate of change on a graph' problem because drawing a specific increasing line would give away the multiple-choice answer. Iteration and f(x)-evaluation problems are genuinely textual and correctly left without figures. Figure cross-checked against the opener numbers.
